slug: 2025-12-09 Ethiopia launches National Digital Payments Strategy 2026-2030

ETH.note: Governor named at the launch, but no licensing, switch oversight or regional link is stated.
No consumer-protection rule or redress body stated.

facts.fact: The National Digital Payment Strategy 2026-2030 proposes enabling low-value outbound cross-border transfers via cards, wallets and digital banking for the first time (FMC/ENA/Shega).

ETH.note: No government payment to people stated.
No survey share of adults with an account stated.
Instant Payment System launch is named, but no mobile money service or interoperability in service is stated.
One-stop centres are cited, but no electronic tax or fee payment is stated.
